kurz: Zopf is a rich yeast dough: butter and milk make it tender and golden brown, but slow the yeast.
bild_im_kopf: A bread in its Sunday best: softer, sweeter, shinier.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Knead the dough well until smooth
schluesselmomente.warum: Butter weakens the network, so it needs kneading in order to rise all the same.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Let it prove a little longer than bread
schluesselmomente.warum: Butter and sugar slow the yeast down.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Braid and let it prove briefly again

schluesselmomente.warum: Protein and sugar brown and shine.
